summary.text: Dan Williams is a Democratic state representative from Chester County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 74 since his election in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former UPS supervisor and longtime pastor, he chairs the House Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Williams has lived in Chester County for more than three decades and is a graduate of Geneva College and Biblical Seminary in Hatfield, according to his official biography.
He is a former UPS supervisor and Teamster member, and has served as senior pastor of New Life in Christ Fellowship Church in Coatesville.
His biography says he led community initiatives that included a guns amnesty program, community-police forums and food and clothing drives.
Williams chairs the House Human Services Committee.
He and his family run the Willia Mae Williams Memorial Scholarship Fund, named for his late mother, which awards merit scholarships to young people.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Lorenzo Kelley as his opponent in the general election.
